interventions.detail: mirror.baidu.com/pypi/simple returns 403; installed paddlepaddle from PyPI
System Python 3.12 build fails (webrtcvad needs Python.h, onnxoptimizer needs cmake); used uv-managed Python 3.10
Installed pip and setuptools (<80) into the venv because paddle imports setuptools and paddlenlp imports pip
Pinned datasets<3 to be compatible with huggingface_hub<0.26
Installed libsndfile1 and ffmpeg via apt as a precaution for audio IO (not proven strictly required)
